features: Four log1p strictly-prior same-season mean period rates: home scored, home allowed, away scored, away allowed. Each rate shrinks by20 prior games toward prior league mean; features are stored before own-game outcomes. No current-game outcomes or odds as inputs.
formula: For classes HOME/AWAY/DRAW estimate sample mean and full4x4 covariance of prior eligible feature vectors. Shrink each class covariance with20 pseudo-observations of the global training covariance; add0.001 diagonal ridge. Bayes class probability proportional to Laplace-smoothed prior frequency times multivariate Gaussian density. ML conditions on non-draw; 3-way uses unconditional maximum.
chronology: Predict all games of each date before updating team outcome histories and Gaussian training statistics; same-season reset, no rolling exclusions or selection of months.
tuning: One design with fixed covariance regularization and confidence; no grids or result-dependent revisions. Materially different from opponent ratings, independent Poisson counts and CatBoost trees.
